_comment: Scheduled macro events. Every entry is verified against the issuing institution's own published schedule — see 'verified'. Add entries only from a primary source; a wrong date on a client-facing page costs more credibility than a short calendar. BLS blocks automated access to its release schedule, so US CPI and jobs dates beyond the next one must be added by hand from bls.gov/schedule.
